Container.Name: nfs-haven-server
Container.Overview: NFS Haven server: one address for the NFS Haven app on Apple TV and Mac. Serves your own copies of the games' data (one folder per game, plus optional mod sets and HD packs) with resumable downloads, keeps every game's saves with version history (shared between Apple TV and Mac), and runs a lobby so network games can be joined over Tailscale.[br][br]Drop your disc images and official updates into the Inbox folder: the server recognises them, keeps them read-only in Sources and builds each game's data by itself (Porsche Unleashed disc + 3.5 update, The Need for Speed SE CD). Or put a game's files in Games/GAME/original/ yourself. Set a Password and enter the same password in the app.[br][br]LAN / Tailscale only: never port-forward this server to the internet.
Container.Requires: Your own copy of each game: its disc image (and official update), or its files.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the app and the status page use.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password the app sends. Enter the same value as the Password in the app: Extras › Network, or the Apple TV Game Data screen. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: One folder per game: porsche/original/ (the game's own files), porsche/mods/NAME/ (mod sets, overlaid on the original), porsche/hd/ (HD pack). A new game is a new folder. Read-write: imports publish sets here (only games/GAME/original is ever replaced).

Config.Name: Inbox
Config.Description: Drop a game's disc image (.img, .bin + .cue, .iso) or an official update here (e.g. over SMB). It is recognised by its contents, moved to Sources and the game's set rebuilt; anything not recognised stays here and is listed on the status page.

Config.Name: Sources
Config.Description: The imported disc images and updates, one folder per game, kept read-only with their checksums (Re-import rebuilds from these).

Config.Name: Staging
Config.Description: Where an import builds and verifies a set before it is swapped into Games (needs room for one game's data). Empty between imports.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saves, save versions and caches. Covered by the normal appdata backup.

Config.Name: Save versions
Config.Description: Earlier copies kept per save file (plus one per day for 30 days).

Config.Name: Lobby timeout
Config.Description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a hosted game leaves the lobby.
